newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX hits record high, consolidation seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX hits record high, consolidation seen.

text.p: Austria's ATX closed firmer after rallying to a record high on Thursday and traders forecast a period of consolidation after recent heady gains.
The blue chip ATX index rose 6.84 points, or 0.44 percent, to 1,480.49. Earlier it touched 1,485.69 -- the highest levels since the index was recalculated in January 1991.
Among its constituents 14 gainers outnumbered seven losers.
"The future ended today at the spot market level for the first time in ages," said one trader. "I think we've seen the high for the next three weeks."
The August ATX future rose 2.6 points to 1,481.6.
"Consolidation of 20 to 30 points would do us a lot of good," said another trader.
The top gainer was viscose fibre maker Lenzing, up 6.69 percent at a year-high of 941 schillings. Traders said price and liquidity was boosted by the news the firm expected to turn a profit in 1998.
Creditanstalt ordinaries were the leading loser, toppling 0.76 percent to 913 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index added 2.62 points, or 0.5 percent, at 528.47.
